sampling_policy: Review every tenth generated alias within each subject family, with at least ten records overall.

explicit_aliases.ambiguity_notes: AI can be used outside a computing course; use programming, algorithms, models, or the stated course context.
CS can abbreviate other course or organization names; use computing, programming, or algorithm context.
English may mean language, writing, or literature; use the stated topic before choosing a task.
Bio can mean Biology or an informal biography label; use science or course context.
DS can abbreviate several subjects or technologies; use data, statistics, or computing context.
IT is also an ordinary English word; require a technology or course context.
SE can abbreviate other subjects or directions; use software-development context.
ME is also an ordinary pronoun and can abbreviate other courses; require engineering context.
EE can abbreviate other educational terms; use circuits, electronics, or engineering context.
CE can abbreviate other courses or credentials; require civil or infrastructure context.
IE can abbreviate other terms; use operations, systems, or engineering context.
RS can abbreviate other subjects; use religion, belief, or course context.
A and P may be an organization or course abbreviation; use human-biology or health-science context.
Geo can refer to geography, geology, geometry, or a general earth prefix; use the topic context.
Stats may also mean a set of numerical results; use course or topic context.
AI may appear outside a course name; use programming, algorithms, or model context.
English may mean language, writing, or literature; use the stated topic.
Design may refer to visual, product, engineering, or software work; use project context.
